IC1: includes presence of all the following:
IC2: - one or more clinical symptoms (persistent cough, recurrent hemoptysis, [OR] weight loss, [OR] malaise, [OR] fever [OR] and dyspnea) for ≥3 months
IC3: - slowly progressive [OR] or persistent radiological findings (one or more cavities [OR] and surrounding fibrosis, [OR] infiltrates, [OR] consolidation, with or without fungal ball [OR] or progressive pleural thickening) on computed tomography (CT) of the thorax
IC4: - immunological (A.fumigatus-specific IgG >27 mgA/L [OR] or positive Aspergillus precipitins) or microbiological evidence of Aspergillus infection (growth of Aspergillus in respiratory secretions [OR] or serum galactomannan index >0.5 [OR] or BALF galactomannan index >1) [AND] and,
IC5: - [NOT] exclusion of other pulmonary disorders with similar presentation.
